cues.en: Continuity is an important feature of functions for differentiation, and it's central to many theorems
cues.zh: 連續性是微分時函數的重要特徵，也是許多微分學定理，

cues.en: in differential calculus, including, well, including the differential ability of a function and the mean value theorem, Rolle's Theorem, intermediate value theorem, and so on.
cues.zh: 的核心，包括函數可微性、中值定理、羅爾定理、介值定理等等。

cues.en: Now a function can be continuous or discontinuous, and if there are discontinuities, then there are
cues.zh: 函數可以連續或不連續，如果有不連續，

cues.en: different types of discontinuities, and you will learn about those different types in this video.
cues.zh: 還有不同種類，這支會學到。

cues.en: Now, conceptually, continuity versus discontinuity is really easy to understand.
cues.zh: 概念上，連續和不連續非常容易理解。

cues.en: It's really straightforward, but in terms of the formal definition.
cues.zh: 很直接，但正式定義方面。

cues.en: So I'm going to tell you about the formal definition and the test for continuity of a function.
cues.zh: 我要介紹正式定義，以及函數連續性的檢驗。

cues.en: But this definition actually relies on understanding how to interpret and compute limits, which is the topic of the next section.
cues.zh: 不過定義依賴如何理解、計算極限，這是下一節主題。

cues.en: So for this video in particular about when it comes to this section of the video, I would like you to focus more on the concepts.
cues.zh: 所以這支，尤其講到那部分時，先著重概念。

cues.en: And then in the next section, we will revisit this topic with a little bit more rigor.
cues.zh: 下一節會更嚴謹地回來探討。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Well, I think you can already imagine what it means for a function to be continuous or discontinuous.
cues.zh: 應該已能想像，函數連續或不連續是什麼意思。

cues.en: So here you see the graphs of several functions and well, what do you think?
cues.zh: 這裡幾張函數圖，你覺得呢？

cues.en: Which ones of these are continuous and which ones have discontinuities?
cues.zh: 哪些連續，哪些有不連續？

cues.en: Okay, Well, I'm sure you figured it out.
cues.zh: 好，相信已經想出。

cues.en: The conceptual test is whether you can trace the entire function without lifting your finger off the page.
cues.zh: 概念性檢驗，就是能否手指不離開紙，一路描完整個函數。

cues.en: And actually, on computers.
cues.zh: 其實電腦上，

cues.en: This works even better.
cues.zh: 更適合。

cues.en: If you can trace the entire function with your mouse, then it's continuous.
cues.zh: 如果能用滑鼠沿著完整函數描過，就是連續。

cues.en: If your mouse would go off the function line to get from one part of the function to the next, then it's discontinuous.
cues.zh: 如果從這部分到另一部分，滑鼠必須離開函數線，就是不連續。

cues.en: So that's pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 很直接。

cues.en: So this function of course is discontinuous.
cues.zh: 這個當然不連續。

cues.en: There is a discontinuity over here.
cues.zh: 這裡有不連續。

cues.en: It's not possible to use the mouse to draw, to follow the function line without well, you can't really lift the mouth off the page, but this is just impossible.
cues.zh: 無法用滑鼠一路沿線畫，當然不能真的把滑鼠從頁面抬起，但就是做不到。

cues.en: There's a gap here, so this is discontinuous, but actually you can also see that functions can be continuous within a subdomain.
cues.zh: 這裡有空隙，所以不連續；不過也能看到，函數在子定義域可以連續。

cues.en: So in fact, when you only consider this restricted domain here from this point up until this point,
cues.zh: 只考慮這個受限定義域，從這點到這點，

cues.en: then this piece of the function is continuous and this piece is also continuous.
cues.zh: 這段連續，另一段也連續。

cues.en: But the entire function as a whole across the entire domain is discontinuous.
cues.zh: 但整個函數、整個定義域，不連續。

cues.en: And actually when it comes to continuity, we often talk about the continuity at a particular point.
cues.zh: 談連續性時，也經常談特定點。

cues.en: So this function here is continuous at this point and it's continuous at this point, but it is discontinuous at this point right here.
cues.zh: 這點連續，那點也連續，但這個點不連續。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now these plots also show that there are different kinds of discontinuities.
cues.zh: 圖也顯示，不連續有不同種類。

cues.en: There's several different kinds of discontinuities, and some books or courses will list multiple like, I don't know, maybe up to five types of discontinuities.
cues.zh: 有幾種，有些書或課可能列到五種左右。

cues.en: Mostly people focus on the three most important discontinuities.
cues.zh: 多數著重最重要的三種。

cues.en: And I'm going to walk you through those.
cues.zh: 我會逐一介紹。

cues.en: Well, they are called Jump Infinite and Removeable discontinuities.
cues.zh: 跳躍不連續、無窮不連續、可去不連續。

cues.en: Let's go through each of those in turn.
cues.zh: 依序看。

cues.en: And actually, first is the continuous functions.
cues.zh: 其實先看連續函數。

cues.en: So these two functions are continuous.
cues.zh: 這兩個都連續。

cues.en: That's pretty easy.
cues.zh: 很容易。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So one kind of discontinuity is called a jump discontinuity.
cues.zh: 一種叫跳躍不連續。

cues.en: And that means that the function suddenly jumps from one value to another value without going through any of the values in between.
cues.zh: 就是函數從一個值突然跳到另一個，沒有經過中間值。

cues.en: Now, you've already seen this type of discontinuity with piecewise functions.
cues.zh: 分段函數已經看過這種。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then we have what are called infinite discontinuities, and that's where the function is not defined at a specific point, but instead the function as it approaches that point, it blows up to infinity
cues.zh: 再來無窮不連續，特定點沒定義，接近時卻衝向正無窮，

cues.en: or down to minus infinity.
cues.zh: 或下降到負無窮。

cues.en: You can see here it can go down to minus infinity and come up from or come down from plus infinity on two sides of the same point.
cues.zh: 同一點兩側，可以一邊向負無窮下降，另一邊從正無窮下降。

cues.en: That's totally fine.
cues.zh: 沒問題。

cues.en: It doesn't need to be symmetric.
cues.zh: 不必對稱。

cues.en: It just needs to go towards infinity to be called an infinite discontinuity.
cues.zh: 只要往無窮，就稱無窮不連續。

cues.en: The tangent function is one example of this kind of discontinuity.
cues.zh: tan 就是一個例子。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then finally, we have removable discontinuities, and that's where the function looks like it should be continuous, except for one point.
cues.zh: 最後，可去不連續，看起來應該連續，只有一點例外。

cues.en: And it's usually a point that's in like a weird spot like this.
cues.zh: 通常有個點放在奇怪位置，像這樣。

cues.en: So you can make this kind of a function with a piecewise definition where you define the function at
cues.zh: 可以用分段定義，讓這個 x 軸，

cues.en: this particular x axis value to be some other value, it could not exist, or that value could be up here.
cues.zh: 值的函數等於其他值，也可以沒有定義，或值在上面這裡。

cues.en: But there are also one piece functions that have these kinds of discontinuities.
cues.zh: 但也有單一公式的函數，出現這種不連續。

cues.en: I will show an example of that in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下會舉例。

cues.en: Now, one thing I would like to point out about, indicating the these kinds of removable discontinuities people often.
cues.zh: 想提醒，可去不連續的表示方式，大家經常。

cues.en: So just visually, we will often draw a big fat circle around the discontinuity.
cues.zh: 視覺上，會在不連續點畫一個大空心圓。

cues.en: In fact, what's usually happening most often is that it's only one point, exactly, one infinitesimal point where you have a discontinuity.
cues.zh: 但實際通常只有恰好一個、無限小的點不連續。

cues.en: But we draw this big empty circle around it to indicate that that is the location of that point.
cues.zh: 畫這個大空心圓，是為了標示位置。

cues.en: You can, you know, if you want, you can imagine that this is like a magnifying lens.
cues.zh: 可以想成放大鏡。

cues.en: So we're zooming in, showing that the function is missing a value at one individual point.
cues.zh: 放大顯示，函數只在單一點少了一個值。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Here you see some specific examples of functions that can produce these different types of discontinuities.
cues.zh: 這裡有會產生不同不連續類型的具體例子。

cues.en: So here we have a piecewise function.
cues.zh: 有一個分段函數。

cues.en: Now, a piecewise function doesn't necessarily lead to a jump discontinuity.
cues.zh: 分段不一定造成跳躍。

cues.en: You could have a piecewise function that is continuous from one piece to the next.
cues.zh: 可以從一段到下一段都連續。

cues.en: So that's also fine.
cues.zh: 也沒問題。

cues.en: Here we have the tangent function which produces an infinite discontinuity, and here's an example of a removable discontinuity.
cues.zh: tan 會產生無窮不連續，這裡則是可去不連續的例子。

cues.en: So this function is defined for all of these points.
cues.zh: 這函數對這些點都有定義。

cues.en: It's continuous for all of these points except when x equals two.
cues.zh: 都連續，只有 x=2 例外。

cues.en: And we can look algebraically what happens when x equals two, we get two squared minus two x, so that's four minus four, which is zero.
cues.zh: 從代數看，x=2 時，2²−2x，也就是四減四，零。

cues.en: And then here we have x squared minus.
cues.zh: 這裡則 x² 減，

cues.en: Fourth, that's also four minus four.
cues.zh: 四，也是四減四。

cues.en: So at exactly x equals two, this function is zero over zero.
cues.zh: 所以恰好 x=2，是 0/0。

cues.en: So it doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 不存在。

cues.en: We're missing a point in there, but otherwise this function is defined and continuous for all of these other points.
cues.zh: 少了一點，但其他這些點都定義且連續。

cues.en: So these are the three most important discontinuities to understand.
cues.zh: 這是最重要的三種不連續。

cues.en: As I mentioned, there are some subtleties.
cues.zh: 如前所說，還有細微區別。

cues.en: There are some additional types of discontinuities.
cues.zh: 還有其他類型。

cues.en: For example, there's another one called An Oscillating Discontinuity, and I will introduce that later in the course.
cues.zh: 例如振盪不連續，後面會介紹。

cues.en: But yeah, these are the most important ones.
cues.zh: 但這三種最重要。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I want to show you the formal definition and also the formal test for whether a function is continuous at a specific point.
cues.zh: 現在正式定義，以及如何正式檢驗函數在特定點連續。

cues.en: Now, as I mentioned at the beginning of this video, this definition and what I'm going to show over here relies on limits which I haven't yet talked about.
cues.zh: 開頭提過，定義和這裡內容依賴尚未談過的極限。

cues.en: So I'm going to try to explain this in high level terms.
cues.zh: 所以用高層次概念說明。

cues.en: If you're already familiar with limits and that's great, you can already understand the definition.
cues.zh: 如果已熟悉極限，很好，已經能理解定義。

cues.en: If not, then that's totally fine.
cues.zh: 不熟也完全沒問題。

cues.en: Don't worry about the notations and the symbols.
cues.zh: 別擔心記號與符號。

cues.en: You will understand all of that in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一節就會理解。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So a function F of X is continuous at a point at point A, so X equals A if these three conditions are
cues.zh: 函數 f(x) 在 a 點，也就是 x=a 連續，如果三個條件，

cues.en: met.
cues.zh: 都滿足。

cues.en: Now, what do these things mean?
cues.zh: 這些是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, the first one I think is is pretty obvious.
cues.zh: 第一個滿明顯。

cues.en: It just means that the function actually exists at point A So imagine, for example, we have the function
cues.zh: 就是函數在 a 確實存在；例如函數，

cues.en: one over x and x equals a, so that function at F of a is one over zero.
cues.zh: 1/x，而 x=a，這裡 f(a)=1/0。

cues.en: So that's not defined.
cues.zh: 所以沒定義。

cues.en: And of course here is another example where the function is not defined at one specific point of x equals two and then points two and three involving limits.
cues.zh: 另一個例子，是 x=2 沒定義；第二、第三點則涉及極限。

cues.en: Basically this means that as we approach point A, as we get closer and closer to zero point A without
cues.zh: 基本上表示，靠近 a 點，越來越近但，

cues.en: actually getting to zero point A, then the output of the function gets closer and closer to the value of the function at point A.
cues.zh: 不真正到 a，函數輸出越來越接近 a 點函數值。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let me walk through a few examples.
cues.zh: 看幾個例子。

cues.en: Here's an example of a continuous function at point A So the function is defined at zero point A and
cues.zh: 這個在 a 連續，函數在 a 有定義，

cues.en: the limits as we approach F of A from something that's a little bit to the left of A and a little bit
cues.zh: 從比 a 稍左、稍右的位置，

cues.en: to the right of a, we get closer and closer to a, then the value of the function is also approaching
cues.zh: 越來越接近 a 時，函數值也越接近，

cues.en: the actual value of the function at exactly f of a Here is another example.
cues.zh: 恰好 f(a) 的實際值；再看另一個。

cues.en: Here we see well F of a does not exist, so that gives us a discontinuity.
cues.zh: f(a) 不存在，所以不連續。

cues.en: The function this function is not continuous at point A Of course it is continuous at many other points
cues.zh: 函數在 a 不連續，當然在許多其他點連續，

cues.en: but is not continuous at point A And here we have another example with a removable discontinuity.
cues.zh: 但 a 不連續；這裡再一個可去不連續例子。

cues.en: So here, let's see.
cues.zh: 看一下。

cues.en: Well, in fact, in this case, 0.2 is true.
cues.zh: 這裡第二點成立。

cues.en: So the limit of F of x as X approaches A does exist.
cues.zh: x 趨近 a 時，f(x) 的極限存在。

cues.en: This limit actually does exist, and the limit is whatever this y axis value is over here.
cues.zh: 極限確實存在，等於這裡的 y 軸值。

cues.en: So in this case, 0.2 is satisfied, but 0.1 and 0.3 are not satisfied.
cues.zh: 所以第二點滿足，第一、第三點不滿足。

cues.en: So therefore this function is discontinuous at zero point A Well, that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 因此函數在 a 不連續。這支就到這裡。

cues.en: Basically a function is continuous.
cues.zh: 基本上函數連續，

cues.en: If there are no discontinuities and there are a few different types of discontinuities that can turn a function from being continuous into discontinuous.
cues.zh: 就是沒有不連續，而不同類型的不連續會讓函數不再連續。

cues.en: Now these discontinuities have implications for computing the derivative and the integral of a function.
cues.zh: 這些會影響函數的微分與積分計算。

cues.en: And I also, in this video show the formal definition of continuity.
cues.zh: 也介紹了連續性的正式定義。

cues.en: And although it relies on concepts that I haven't yet introduced, I hope you found the explanation to be comprehensible.
cues.zh: 雖然依賴尚未介紹的概念，希望解釋仍容易理解。
